text: Playwright is a deterministic script framework where you code exact selectors and steps up front, and it only fails or drifts when the page's HTML changes; Codex's browser use is an AI agent that looks at the screen with vision and reasons about where to click in real time, so it can handle messy, unpredictable UIs and "try to break things" without you writing any selectors. The tradeoff is that Codex is slower, costs more, and is less reliable for the same repeatable task, which is exactly why the video says to reach for a plain Playwright/macro script first and only use vision-based browser use when the flow genuinely needs eyes and judgment.

Если сравнивать Codex Browser Agent с Claude Computer Use, то у них очень четкое разделение задач: Codex на голову удобнее для чистого веба за счет headless-режима в фоне, встроенного менеджера паролей, сохранения навыков в готовые пайплайны (Skills) и мощного QA-тестирования верстки, которое не блокирует работу за компом. text:
Hi, I really enjoy your AI content and I think you provide a lot of valuable information.

I just wanted to offer one piece of constructive feedback. You speak extremely fast in many of your videos. For native English speakers this may not be a problem, but many of us following your channel are non-native English speakers, and the speed can make the content very difficult to follow.

One of the most important parts of teaching is maintaining a good speaking rhythm so the audience has enough time to understand and process the information. Sometimes I personally stop watching halfway through—not because the subject isn't interesting, but because trying to keep up with the speed becomes exhausting and the video starts losing its educational value.

I’m sure I’m not the only one. Hundreds or probably thousands of non-native English speakers follow AI channels like yours because we genuinely want to learn from you.

Slowing down just a little would make your already good content much easier to understand and much more useful to a wider international audience.

Just friendly feedback from someone who enjoys your work and wants to keep watching. 👍
